- Procurement path: Orion Health prefers PO for enterprise purchases. Pilot purchases are often done via PO as well (we can route one internally).
- Card vs PO: Card is only used for subscriptions under ~$5k/year; this pilot will exceed that once scaled, so PO is the right path.
- Marketplace: we are evaluating GCP Marketplace but procurement has not approved a marketplace-first flow yet. If Redwood is on GCP Marketplace that could speed purchase, but not required.
- Budget owner: budget is owned by Clinical ML Programs — Lara Singh (Director, Clinical ML) — I’ve cc’d her.
- Signatory: legal / signature authority sits with the CFO for commercial contracts > $50k — Michael O'Connell (m.oconnell@orionhealth.com).

I’ll ask Lara to confirm if she wants to be the finance sponsor or to delegate to her manager. I’ve also attached the internal vendor onboarding guide they referenced today.
